expected_findings.behavior: Saving disabled email notifications omits the false value, so the next load restores the default value of true.
expected_findings.impact: Users who disabled email notifications begin receiving them again after settings are reloaded or the process restarts.
evidence: Load decodes persisted JSON over Defaults, where EmailNotifications is true.
The new omitempty tag removes an explicitly false EmailNotifications value from saved JSON.
The added test checks the default and enabled values but not a disabled save/load round trip.
